metadata.description: Danny's work skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: devseed-writing
plugins.description: Guide for writing blog posts and project pages for the Development Seed website. Use when creating or editing content in content/blog/ or content/project/ directories, or when the user asks for help writing blog posts or project pages.

plugins.name: map-to-poster
plugins.description: Transforms cities into minimalist map posters. Use when the user asks to create a map poster, generate city-based art, or visualize a geographic area using MapToPoster.

plugins.name: satellite-image
plugins.description: Fetch recent Sentinel-2 satellite imagery from Microsoft Planetary Computer. Use when the user wants satellite photos, earth observation images, or remote sensing data for a location.

plugins.name: stac-scaffolder
plugins.description: Scaffolds a STAC (SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog) project using pystac. Use when the user wants to create a STAC catalog, organize geospatial datasets, or generate metadata for satellite imagery and earth observation data.

plugins.name: project-video
plugins.description: Generates short highlight reel videos for software projects. Use when the user wants a project video, demo reel, highlight video, showcase, or changelog video for a GitHub repo.

plugins.name: slack-to-markdown
plugins.description: Extracts Slack conversations — single threads, channel message ranges, or "from this message to now" — from a URL and saves as formatted Markdown. Use when the user wants to archive, share, or summarize a Slack discussion. Supports --since/--until date filtering, --threads to expand replies inline, and --from-here to export a channel from a linked message onward.

plugins.name: apps-script-drive-viewer
plugins.description: Build a Google Apps Script web app that reads data from Google Drive and serves HTML, restricted to a Google Workspace domain. Use when a team wants a click-to-view URL for confidential data without GitHub Pages or download-and-open friction.

plugins.name: ai-impact-audit
plugins.description: Run a skeptical, evidence-grounded audit of the real value the AI assistance has given you, separating genuine impact from output volume, scaffolding, and the AI cleaning up after itself. Use when someone asks what working with AI has actually done for them, wants an honest assessment of an AI-assisted workflow, or wants to judge whether an AI setup is worth it.

plugins.name: devseed-tarot
plugins.description: Draws a fun, DevSeed-flavored tarot reading from any git repo, project, or vault — no topic needed (it grounds in recent commit activity) or with a question as the lens. Renders as an on-brand local web page: welcome screen, face-down cards you turn yourself, animated chart-fragment card art, and a toggle between a generic DevSeed reading and one grounded in the repo's real signal. Use when someone asks for a tarot reading or a fun gut-check on a project.

plugins.name: port-to-open-standard
plugins.description: Convert proprietary IDE commands (like Claude Code custom slash commands) into cross-platform skills, commands, or MCP servers that work across Antigravity, Claude Code, and Cursor. Scaffold new standard workflows.
